description: In the input you will see several red pixels along the top edge of a non-black background and several teal pixels along the left edge, as well as black rectangular obstacles scattered through the interior. To make the output: 1. For each red pixel, shoot a red beam straight downward, one cell at a time, and stop the beam just before it would enter a black obstacle or the bottom edge. 2. For each teal pixel, shoot a teal beam straight rightward, one cell at a time, and stop the beam just before it would enter a black obstacle or the right edge. 3. Wherever a red beam and a teal beam overlap, color that cell orange. 4. Finally, remove the original red‐and‐teal seed pixels from the output.
